# Pharlux

> Pharlux is a single statically-linked Rust binary delivering unified OpenTelemetry-native observability (metrics and logs; traces in V1.1) for small teams running 1-10 services on a single VPS. One binary, one `pharlux.toml`, one systemd unit — no external databases, no Docker, no multi-component stack. Dual-licensed: Community edition is free under AGPL-3.0; commercial licenses available for teams that cannot accept AGPL terms or need the Enterprise binary. V1.0.0 shipped 2026-04-17.

Pharlux is a product of Veltara Works. It targets teams currently running the Grafana + Prometheus + Loki stack who are frustrated with operating five moving parts to observe three services. The design philosophy is single-binary simplicity: storage is a custom write-ahead log plus per-signal Apache Parquet files queried through embedded Apache DataFusion. HTTP (Axum) and gRPC (Tonic) share one Tokio runtime. TLS uses `rustls` throughout — zero OpenSSL in the dependency tree.

Performance on a 4 vCPU / 8 GB VPS: 577k points/sec sustained, 7 ms average latency, 0 errors over 17.36 M points during a 30-second load test, fully reproducible with a load generator that ships in the source tree.

- [Pharlux homepage](https://pharlux.com/): product overview, pricing, and commercial licensing contact.

## Pricing

- [Pricing page](https://pharlux.com/pricing): full tier comparison — Community (free, AGPL-3.0), Team ($49/mo), Business ($199/mo), Scale ($899/mo), and Custom / Air-gapped (from $12,000/mo).
- [Machine-readable pricing](https://pharlux.com/pricing.md): plans, prices, and limits in plain Markdown for programmatic comparison.

## Benchmarks

- [Benchmarks](https://pharlux.com/benchmarks): first-party sustained-ingest results (577k points/sec on a 4 vCPU / 8 GB VPS) with full reproduction methodology.

## Comparisons

- [Compare Pharlux](https://pharlux.com/compare/): how Pharlux compares to the major self-hosted and SaaS observability tools.
- [Pharlux vs Grafana Loki](https://pharlux.com/compare/grafana-loki/): one binary versus the LGTM stack.
- [Pharlux vs SigNoz](https://pharlux.com/compare/signoz/): unified observability without operating ClickHouse.
- [Pharlux vs Prometheus](https://pharlux.com/compare/prometheus/): metrics and logs in one binary versus a metrics-only core plus a stack.
- [Pharlux vs Datadog](https://pharlux.com/compare/datadog/): a self-hosted, flat-priced alternative to per-host SaaS.
- [Pharlux vs OpenObserve](https://pharlux.com/compare/openobserve/): two Rust single binaries compared by scope.
- [Pharlux vs VictoriaMetrics](https://pharlux.com/compare/victoriametrics/): unified metrics + logs versus a dedicated metrics store.
